elements.note: Three-pile cap on a trapezoidal plan -- one pile on the top edge at mid-width and two on the bottom edge, matching the 1.40 x 1.30 dimension chains. Two plan views are given: an outline plan and a reinforcement plan below it.
Vertical section through the single-pile cap, carrying the full depth chain 1.00 / 0.50 / 0.30 / 0.08 / 0.08 and the 0.10 lean-concrete projection each side.
0.70 x 0.70 square cap with the eight Ø16 bars drawn round the perimeter and the Ø9 ties drawn as a square plus a diamond (the diamond is the second, rotated tie of the '2ป.' pair).
Section through two of the three piles, giving 1.00 to the cap top, a 0.20 cap, 0.05 pile-head embedment, then 0.08 lean concrete over 0.08 sand.

Two stacked plans: the upper one shows the cap outline, the column (hatched) and the three pile positions (dashed); the lower one repeats it with the reinforcement drawn and tagged 6-Ø9, 3-Ø12 and 3-Ø9.

warnings: First of the pile-cap enlargement sheets. F1 (1 pile) and F3 (3 piles) -- confirming the F<n> = pile-count convention read off the S-02 plan.

F1 AND F3 ARE BUILT VERY DIFFERENTLY, which is worth keeping straight: F1 is a deep 0.80 m block (0.50 above the pile head plus 0.30 of pile embedment) reinforced like a short column with 8 Ø16 verticals and 2-leg Ø9 ties at 0.10; F3 is a shallow 0.20 m mat with only 0.05 of pile embedment, reinforced with 3-Ø12 + 6-Ø9 top and bottom and a Ø9 perimeter binder.

PILE-HEAD LEVEL DIFFERS between the two: -1.50 under F1 (1.00 + 0.50) and -1.20 under F3 (1.00 + 0.20). Both are computed from the printed chains, not printed as levels themselves -- only the ระดับหัวเสาเข็ม arrow is drawn.
The F3 bottom-bar tags are printed twice with slightly different spacing ('3-Ø12 มม. +6-Ø9 มม.' vs '3-Ø12 มม.+ 6-Ø9 มม.'). Same bars, transcribed as printed in each position.

The trailing ⌐ / ⌐-like glyph after the F1 4+4 Ø12 and both F3 bar tags is the standard hook symbol on these sheets. It is kept in printed_as rather than being turned into a bend length, which the sheet does not give.
Both details defer the pier above to another sheet ('ตอม่อดูขยายเสา'), i.e. the column schedule on S-11 (PNG 44). No pier reinforcement is shown here.

The remaining marks used on the S-02 plan -- F6, F8, F10, F12 and F16 -- must be on S-08 to S-10. The S-01 index calls the fourth of those sheets 'ขยายฐานรากเสาเข็ม F18', a mark that does not appear on the plan; that discrepancy is still open at this point in the set.
